product_family: Google Translate: free web-based translation tool (translate.google.com) and enterprise Cloud Translation API (Basic & Advanced editions) using Neural Machine Translation.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Google Cloud undergoes a regular third-party audit to certify individual products against SOC 2 standards. SOC 2 reports are generated by an objective third party attesting to assertions made by Google Cloud about its controls.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: Google Cloud maintains multiple compliance certifications including ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and SOC 2 (Type 1 and Type 2 reports).

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Google Cloud Services ISMS has received an accredited ISO/IEC 27001 certification after undergoing an audit by an independent third party.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27017
certifications.proof_quote: Google Cloud maintains multiple compliance certifications including ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and SOC 2 (Type 1 and Type 2 reports).

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27018
certifications.proof_quote: Google Cloud maintains multiple compliance certifications including ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and SOC 2 (Type 1 and Type 2 reports).

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701
certifications.proof_quote: Google Cloud maintains multiple compliance certifications including ISO 27701 covering privacy management systems.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Google is a processor and customers are controllers or processors of customer personal data. Google operates a global infrastructure designed to provide state-of-the-art security through the entire information processing lifecycle, including secure deployment of services, secure storage of data, secure communications.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: There is no certification recognized by the US HHS for HIPAA compliance and complying with HIPAA is a shared responsibility between the customer and Google. Google Cloud Platform supports HIPAA compliance within the scope of a Business Associate Agreement.

certifications.name: FedRAMP High
certifications.proof_quote: The FedRAMP Board has issued a FedRAMP High Provisional Authority to Operate (P-ATO) to Google Cloud and the underlying infrastructure.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Google's PCI DSS certification meets the PCI DSS 4.0.1 compliance standard. Google Cloud undergoes at least an annual third-party audit to certify individual products against the PCI DSS.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 certification found in Google's official trust center documentation.

certifications.name: CSA STAR AI
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR AI certification found in Google's official trust center documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Google explicitly states: 'Google does not use the content you send to train and improve our Google Translation features.' Data is held briefly in-memory for translation processing only and is not retained or used for model improvement.
privacy.data_region: Multiple regions available including EU (Belgium, Germany, Finland, Switzerland, UK, Netherlands); customers can choose data residency.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Data encrypted with Transport Layer Security (TLS)

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Customer content encrypted at rest using encryption methods in Google Cloud services

security.name: Data Residency
security.value: Customers can choose data storage regions (EU, UK, Switzerland, Belgium, Germany, Finland, Netherlands, and others)

security.name: Subprocessor Management
security.value: Before onboarding subprocessors, Google conducts security and privacy audits; subprocessors must enter into security, confidentiality, and privacy contract terms

security.name: Data Handling
security.value: Text held briefly in-memory for translation; not persistently stored or used for training; content not shared with third parties; Google does not claim ownership of submitted content

security.name: Incident Response
security.value: Data breach defined and covered under GDPR-aligned data processing agreements with defined incident response procedures

products.name: Google Translate Web (Free)
products.data_scope: Limited to 5,000 characters per query; rate-limited; experimental features possible; uses Neural Machine Translation
products.notes: Consumer-grade free service; no SLA; subject to rate limits and experimental updates

products.name: Cloud Translation API - Basic Edition
products.data_scope: 500,000 free characters per month; unlimited characters beyond free tier; REST API integration
products.notes: Enterprise-grade with SLA; suitable for mission-critical applications; per-character pricing model

products.name: Cloud Translation API - Advanced Edition
products.data_scope: Glossary support, batch translation, document translation, real-time translation capabilities
products.notes: Enterprise-grade with advanced customization; additional features for specialized translation needs; higher pricing for advanced features

compare.pricing_model: Free tier (web tool) | Cloud API: pay-per-character (Basic: $15 per 1M characters, Advanced: $20 per 1M characters)
compare.data_residency: Multi-region with customer control over residency (EU/US/APAC and other regions available)

flags: Two distinct products with different compliance scopes: free web tool (translate.google.com) is consumer-grade with limited documentation; Cloud Translation API has full enterprise compliance. AIFoxx lists 'Google Translate' without clarifying which product.
HIPAA coverage is not a formal certification but a BAA-based shared responsibility model. Customers must ensure their own HIPAA compliance when using Google Cloud services.
No AI governance certifications (ISO 42001, CSA STAR AI) found; these are emerging standards and Google may not have pursued them yet.
FedRAMP High: P-ATO (Provisional Authority to Operate), not full ATO. Assured Workloads required for FedRAMP Moderate/High deployments.
Data residency for Google Translate web tool (translate.google.com) is not customer-controllable; only Cloud Translation API offers residency options.
